points.description: States that the equalization tank balances (equalizes/evens out) fluctuating flows or concentrations (flow rate and/or strength/load of the wastewater) before treatment.
points.partial_credit: Half (0.5) if only says it balances/equalizes without naming fluctuating flow or concentration, or names only one clearly without the balancing role stated precisely.

points.description: States that it assists self-neutralization (of acidic and alkaline wastes) AND evens out the effect of periodic slug discharges from a batch process.
points.partial_credit: Half (0.5) if only one of the two (self-neutralization, or evening out slug discharge from batch process) is stated precisely.

rubric.notes: Full marks need all three roles from the model answer in correct technical terms: balancing fluctuating flows/concentrations; assisting self-neutralization; evening out periodic slug discharges from batch processes. Part marks only when clearly more than half of a point is stated precisely, as described. Vague statements like 'stores water' or 'improves treatment', or any wrong statement in a point, earn nothing for that point.
